source_text.body:
Produce a short film end to end with an agent
The poster says Claude Code wrote the script, voiced lines with a local TTS model, made the music, rendered frames in headless Chrome, and mixed it with ffmpeg.
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The poster says Claude Code handled the film pipeline itself: it wrote the script, used character drawings from the Agent Standup app, voiced each line with the local Kokoro TTS model, generated the music, rendered frames in headless Chrome, and mixed everything with ffmpeg. It then ran Whisper on the finished audio to catch any cut-off lines; the only human contribution the post names is that the interviews were fictionalized.
How it went
The result was a finished short film attached to the post. The source also says about 12 seconds near the end are not staged but real footage of the app showing real agent sessions.
Worth knowing
A useful check to copy is the final Whisper transcription pass, which the poster used to verify no sentence was accidentally cut.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Help me make a [length, e.g. 60-second] short film about [premise] in the folder [path]. Write the script, generate voiceover with a local text-to-speech tool, create or source background music, render the visuals as frames, and assemble everything with ffmpeg. Finish with one playable file named [filename] and a short note on how to re-render it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xch4d1/i_interviewed_my_claude_code_agents_the_human_did
